input: Interview my uncle about his immigration story on video

gold.taskTitle: Video Interview Uncle About His Immigration Story
gold.taskDescription: Plan and conduct a recorded video interview with the user's uncle to capture his personal immigration story.

questions.title: What country did your uncle immigrate from and to?
questions.description: Understand the geographic and cultural context of the immigration story.

questions.title: What is your deadline or target date for this interview?
questions.description: Establish a timeline to work backward from for preparation steps.

questions.title: What device will you use to record the video?
questions.description: Identify whether the user has a phone, camera, or other recording equipment available.

questions.title: Will the interview be in person or done remotely?
questions.description: Determine the logistics of the interview setup, which affects equipment and platform needs.

questions.title: What is the intended audience or purpose of this video?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a personal keepsake, a family archive, a school project, or something else.

questions.title: How long do you want the final video to be?
questions.description: Understand the desired length to guide how many questions to prepare and how to edit.

questions.title: Does your uncle know this interview is planned yet?
questions.description: Determine whether coordination and scheduling with the uncle is still needed.
